map.绩效考核工具。按多维度加权计算绩效总分、归一化与排名，用于员工考核的量化评分与等: The performance appraisal tool computes a weighted performance total, normalizes and ranks it across dimensions for quantitative employee scoring and grading, with data processed locally.
map.多维度加权计算绩效总分、归一化与排名: Multi-dimensional weighted performance total, normalization and ranking
map.多指标考核（业绩 40%、能力 30%、价值观 30%）按权重求和。: Multi-indicator appraisal (performance 40%, capability 30%, values 30%) sums by weight.
map.OKR 与 KPI 混合时，给不同维度配权后合成总分。: When OKRs and KPIs are mixed, weight the dimensions differently and then combine them into a total score.
map.校准会上统一量纲，避免部门间松紧不一。: Unify the scale in the calibration meeting to avoid inconsistent strictness across departments.
